visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman standing in a modern hallway with a black and white checkered floor and walls. She has long brown hair, wears a white lace tank top and black shoulder bag, and smiles broadly at the camera. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) A transition shows the interior of a Haidilao restaurant. A staff member in a red uniform and white mask works at a manicure station. The main character shows a close-up of her hand with 'cat-eye' purple nails. (3) The scene shifts to a dining table where the woman uses a tablet to check her queue number. The background features warm wood paneling and other diners in the distance. (4) In a series of jump cuts, the woman is seen eating hotpot food. She uses chopsticks to lift noodles and bites into them enthusiastically. The lighting remains bright and natural. (5) The woman returns to the manicure station. The staff member uses a professional nail file on the woman's nails. Bottles of nail polish and a UV lamp are visible on the counter. (6) Close-up shots follow, detailing the application of purple gel polish and the use of the curing lamp. The staff member's hands are steady and precise. (7) The finished manicure is displayed prominently. The woman holds a glass of water, and digital sparkle effects are added to emphasize the shine of the cat-eye nails. (8) A large platter containing dragon fruit, watermelon, and deep-fried buns with condensed milk is presented. The woman points to it with a happy expression. (9) The final shot shows the entrance of the Haidilao Hot Pot Xinyi branch with its brand logo and signage clearly visible in a mall environment.
